title: Allocator war estate and program feed registry
routing_law: A route supplies bounded observation IDs, fields, controls, and acquisition obligations to a consumer.
A route does not transfer the source object's authority ceiling or create a finding in the consumer.
Controls, refused inferences, nulls, failed paths, and open denominators travel with supportive observations.
No route creates identity, relationship, participation, graph, hop, prevalence, coordination, common-purpose, or publication authority.
